text: First release: functions accompany paper Wu, Shi Tong (2026), “Precision imputed mean standard deviation five-number summary”. se_imputed_df() takes meta-analysis data set, one row per study, reads reporting scenario columns row , appends imputed mean SD naive exact plug-standard errors. row sample mean SD scenario "sample", row mean, minimum maximum SD "mean_range": mean kept, SD imputed range. two groups per row, se_imputed_diff() adds effect study naive exact standard error, names metafor::rma() takes : difference means (measure = "MD", default) log variability ratio (measure = "lnVR"). pool_imputed() pools studies se_imputed_diff() one call, naive exact standard errors side side, common-effect model (method = "EE", default) DerSimonian-Laird random-effects model ("DL"): pooled estimate, standard error, confidence interval p-value, Q, ^2, tau^2 weights. REML estimators stay metafor, takes columns. se_imputed() returns one study’s imputed mean SD plug-standard errors, object class "se_imputed": list compact print. row se_imputed_df() whose standard errors zero (sample SD zero, summary whose values equal) gets NA named warning rows used. c_mu(), c_sigma() inflation_factors() give exact factors every sample size: reported quantile fixed combination two neighboring order statistics definition type (1 9 quantile(), default 7). moments, estimators factors exact n. c_mu_shortcut() c_sigma_shortcut() give closed-form shortcut formulas, comparison use without package. Every function defaults BLUE: version = "blue" study-level functions inflation_factors(), method = "blue" others. version = "wan_luo_shi" method presets give estimators Wan, Luo Shi, exact every sample size well. estimator_weights(), scenario_ranks() imputed_moments() give weights, reported ranks second moments imputed statistics. exact moments normal order statistics come package osmoments. data set vitd carries six studies vitamin D meta-analysis Nnoaham Clarke (2008), vignette two-meta-analyses reproduces two meta-analyses Wu, Shi Tong (2026), one means vitd one SDs metamedian::dat.age.
